description: This file defines the 'User' entity class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations to specify the database mapping for user-related data, including properties like username, password, status, timestamps, roles, and associations with other entities such as Employee and UserRole.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Entity class representing a system user with properties for username, password, status, timestamps, role, and relationships to employee and authentication providers, using Doctrine ORM for persistence mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the user.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the user.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username of the user.

methods.name: setUserName
methods.description: Sets the username of the user.

methods.name: getUserPassword
methods.description: Returns the password of the user.

methods.name: setUserPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for the user.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the user is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the user as deleted or not.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the active/inactive status of the user.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the active/inactive status for the user.

methods.name: getDateEntered
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the user was created.

methods.name: setDateEntered
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: getDateModified
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of last modification.

methods.name: setDateModified
methods.description: Sets the last modified timestamp.

methods.name: getModifiedUserId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who last modified this record.

methods.name: setModifiedUserId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user who last modified this record.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the creator of this user record.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the ID of the creator.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the associated Employee entity.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with this user, if any.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this user.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the role assigned to this user.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Sets the role for this user.

methods.name: getAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns the authentication providers linked to this user.

methods.name: setAuthProviders
methods.description: Sets the list of authentication providers.
